Blaze Pizza Menu: Special Offers and Deals

Blaze Pizza has revolutionized the way we enjoy pizza with its fast-fired, customizable pizzas, catering to a wide range of tastes and dietary preferences. Whether you’re in the mood for a classic favorite or looking to try a unique combination, Blaze Pizza offers a variety of options. In this article, we will break down Blaze Pizza’s menu, including pricing tables for different offerings, signature pizzas, side dishes, delivery details, and special offers available.

Build Your Own Pizza

Blaze Pizza’s Build Your Own Pizza option is one of the most popular choices. Customers can start with an 11-inch or large pizza base and add their favorite toppings. You can select from a wide array of fresh ingredients, including different cheeses, vegetables, proteins, and sauces.

Build Your Own Pizza Pricing Table

Size Price
11-inch $8.95
Large Pizza $13.95

Blaze Signature Pizzas

For those who prefer a pre-selected combination of toppings, Blaze offers a variety of signature pizzas. These pizzas are crafted by Blaze’s chefs and designed to satisfy all your pizza cravings. Each signature pizza is a delightful mix of flavors, created with high-quality ingredients.

Signature Pizza Pricing Table

Pizza Option Price
11-inch $9.45
Large Pizza $14.95

Blaze Signature Pizza Options

  • Meat Eater: A hearty pizza featuring pepperoni, Italian sausage, red onion, and mozzarella with red sauce.
  • BBQ Chicken: Grilled chicken, mozzarella, red onion, banana peppers, gorgonzola, and a BBQ sauce drizzle.
  • Veg Out: Zucchini, mushrooms, red onion, mozzarella, gorgonzola, red sauce dollops, and pesto drizzle.

Toppings and Customizations

One of the best things about Blaze Pizza is its wide selection of toppings, allowing you to truly make your pizza your own. Whether you love classic mozzarella and pepperoni or prefer more adventurous options like artichokes and spicy chorizo, the possibilities are endless.

Available Toppings:

  • Cheeses: Mozzarella, ricotta, parmesan, vegan cheese, ovalini mozzarella.
  • Meats: Pepperoni, grilled chicken, crumbled meatballs, Italian sausage, spicy chorizo.
  • Veggies: Artichokes, red onion, banana peppers, roasted red peppers, jalapeno peppers.
  • Sauces: Spicy red sauce, BBQ sauce, pesto drizzle, house-made red sauce.

Blaze Pizza’s New Signature Pizzas

Blaze Pizza has introduced some exciting new signature pizzas that bring even more flavor and creativity to the menu. These pizzas feature bold combinations and cater to a variety of preferences, including low-carb and keto options.

New Signature Pizzas Pricing Table

Pizza Option Price
11-inch Keto $11.45
11-inch Meatball $10.45

New Signature Pizza Options

  • Spicy Chorizo: This pizza packs a punch with spicy chorizo, mozzarella, red sauce dollops, banana peppers, and jalapenos.
  • Meatball Pie: A meat lover’s dream with crumbled meatballs, ricotta cheese, parmesan sprinkles, and home-made red sauce.
  • Keto Crust Pizza: A keto-friendly crust with spicy red sauce, mozzarella, Italian sausage, mushrooms, and arugula.

Take Two Deal

For those who want a bit of variety, Blaze Pizza’s Take Two Deal is a perfect option. This deal allows you to choose two smaller portions, such as half of an 11-inch pizza with a side salad or cheesy bread. It’s great for a light lunch or if you want to mix and match different flavors.

Take Two Deal Pricing Table

Combo Option Price
Pizza + Salad $8.95
Pizza + Cheesy Bread $9.45

Keto and Gluten-Free Options

Blaze Pizza also offers keto and gluten-free options, making it easy for everyone to enjoy a delicious pizza without compromising their dietary needs. These crusts are made to suit specific health requirements while still offering all the flavor of a traditional pizza.

Keto Pizza Pricing Table

Size Price
11-inch Keto $11.45

Sides and Cheesy Bread

Blaze Pizza doesn’t just stop at pizzas. They also offer delicious sides like cheesy bread, salads, and desserts, making for a full and satisfying meal. Their cheesy bread is particularly popular, offering a gooey, cheesy, garlicky experience perfect for dipping in sauces.

Sides Pricing Table

Side Item Price
Cheesy Bread $5.25
Side Salad $4.95
S’mores Pie $3.45

Blaze Pizza’s Delivery and Ordering Online

Blaze Pizza offers convenient online ordering and delivery services, making it easy to get your favorite pizza wherever you are. You can order through the Blaze Pizza website or mobile app, customize your order, and even track your pizza from the oven to your doorstep.

Delivery Fee Table

Order Option Delivery Fee
Standard Delivery $2.99
First Order Free

Blaze Pizza Special Offers

Blaze Pizza is known for offering fantastic special deals. From $5 pizza deals to discounts for students, there’s always something exciting on the Blaze Pizza menu for bargain hunters.

Current Special Offers:

  • $5 Fridays: Any 11-inch pizza for just $5 every Friday.
  • Student Discount: 10% off your order with a valid student ID.
  • Free Delivery: Available on your first online order.

Special Offers Pricing Table

Offer Discount

Desserts and Sweets

Don’t forget about dessert! Blaze Pizza offers a selection of sweet treats to finish off your meal. Their s’mores pie is a fan favorite, combining graham cracker, chocolate, and marshmallow in a delicious, gooey package.

Desserts Pricing Table

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I Order Blaze Pizza for Catering?

Yes! Blaze Pizza offers catering services for events of all sizes. Whether you’re feeding a small gathering or a large crowd, you can order pizzas, sides, and salads in bulk. Contact Blaze Pizza directly to discuss your catering options.

What Are the Best Signature Pizzas at Blaze?

Blaze Pizza’s signature pizzas are customer favorites for a reason. Popular choices include the Meat Eater, BBQ Chicken, and Veg Out. If you’re looking for something new, try the Spicy Chorizo or Keto Crust pizza.

Does Blaze Pizza Offer Vegan Options?

Yes! Blaze Pizza has several vegan options, including vegan cheese and a variety of plant-based toppings. You can build your own vegan pizza or enjoy one of their signature recipes modified to suit your preferences.

Can I Track My Blaze Pizza Order?

Absolutely! Blaze Pizza’s online ordering system allows you to track your order from the moment it enters the oven until it arrives at your door.

What Is the Delivery Fee for Blaze Pizza?

Blaze Pizza’s delivery fee is $2.99, though they often run promotions that include free delivery, especially for first-time orders.

 

If you’re craving more hearty comfort food, check out our City BBQ Menu for slow-smoked meats, classic sides, and family packs that hit the spot.

Conclusion

Blaze Pizza continues to set the bar high with its customizable pizza options, signature pizzas, and great value through special deals. Whether you’re looking for a keto-friendly meal, a gluten-free crust, or just a great deal, Blaze Pizza has something for everyone. Don’t forget to take advantage of their delivery services and special offers
